# pve_backup_jobs (Data Source)

Configured vzdump backup jobs; optionally the volumes included in one job.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_backup_jobs" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `item_id` (String) The job ID.

### Read-Only

- `backup_jobs` (Attributes List) Returned by /cluster/backup. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--backup_jobs))
- `id` (String) Identifier: <item_id>.
- `included_volumes` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--included_volumes))

<a id="nestedatt--backup_jobs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `backup_jobs`

Read-Only:

- `all` (Boolean) Backup all known guest systems on this host.
- `api_id` (String) The job ID.
- `bwlimit` (Number) Limit I/O bandwidth (in KiB/s).
- `comment` (String) Description for the Job.
- `compress` (String) Compress dump file.
- `dumpdir` (String) Store resulting files to specified directory.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable or disable the job.
- `exclude` (String) Exclude specified guest systems (assumes --all)
- `exclude_path` (List of String) Exclude certain files/directories (shell globs). Paths starting with '/' are anchored to the container's root, other paths match relative to each subdirectory.
- `fleecing` (Attributes) Options for backup fleecing (VM only). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--backup_jobs--fleecing))
- `ionice` (Number) Set IO priority when using the BFQ scheduler. For snapshot and suspend mode backups of VMs, this only affects the compressor. A value of 8 means the idle priority is used, otherwise the best-effort priority is used with the specified value.
- `lockwait` (Number) Maximal time to wait for the global lock (minutes).
- `mailnotification` (String) Deprecated: use notification targets/matchers instead. Specify when to send a notification mail
- `mailto` (String) Deprecated: Use notification targets/matchers instead. Comma-separated list of email addresses or users that should receive email notifications.
- `mode` (String) Backup mode.
- `next_run` (Number) UNIX timestamp when this backup job will be executed next
- `node` (String) Only run if executed on this node.
- `notes_template` (String) Template string for generating notes for the backup(s). It can contain variables which will be replaced by their values. Currently supported are {{cluster}}, {{guestname}}, {{node}}, and {{vmid}}, but more might be added in the future. Needs to be a single line, newline and backslash need to be escaped as '\n' and '\\' respectively.
- `notification_mode` (String) Determine which notification system to use. If set to 'legacy-sendmail', vzdump will consider the mailto/mailnotification parameters and send emails to the specified address(es) via the 'sendmail' command. If set to 'notification-system', a notification will be sent via PVE's notification system, and the mailto and mailnotification will be ignored. If set to 'auto' (default setting), an email will be sent if mailto is set, and the notification system will be used if not.
- `pbs_change_detection_mode` (String) PBS mode used to detect file changes and switch encoding format for container backups.
- `performance` (Attributes) Other performance-related settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--backup_jobs--performance))
- `pigz` (Number) Use pigz instead of gzip when N>0. N=1 uses half of cores, N>1 uses N as thread count.
- `pool` (String) Backup all known guest systems included in the specified pool.
- `protected` (Boolean) If true, mark backup(s) as protected.
- `prune_backups` (Attributes) Use these retention options instead of those from the storage configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--backup_jobs--prune_backups))
- `quiet` (Boolean) Be quiet.
- `remove` (Boolean) Prune older backups according to 'prune-backups'.
- `repeat_missed` (Boolean) If true, the job will be run as soon as possible if it was missed while the scheduler was not running.
- `schedule` (String) Backup schedule. The format is a subset of `systemd` calendar events.
- `script` (String) Use specified hook script.
- `stdexcludes` (Boolean) Exclude temporary files and logs.
- `stop` (Boolean) Stop running backup jobs on this host.
- `stopwait` (Number) Maximal time to wait until a guest system is stopped (minutes).
- `storage` (String) Store resulting file to this storage.
- `tmpdir` (String) Store temporary files to specified directory.
- `vmid` (String) The ID of the guest system you want to backup.
- `zstd` (Number) Zstd threads. N=0 uses half of the available cores, if N is set to a value bigger than 0, N is used as thread count.

<a id="nestedatt--backup_jobs--fleecing"></a>
### Nested Schema for `backup_jobs.fleecing`

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable backup fleecing. Cache backup data from blocks where new guest writes happen on specified storage instead of copying them directly to the backup target. This can help guest IO performance and even prevent hangs, at the cost of requiring more storage space.
- `storage` (String) Use this storage to storage fleecing images. For efficient space usage, it's best to use a local storage that supports discard and either thin provisioning or sparse files.


<a id="nestedatt--backup_jobs--performance"></a>
### Nested Schema for `backup_jobs.performance`

Read-Only:

- `max_workers` (Number) Applies to VMs. Allow up to this many IO workers at the same time.
- `pbs_entries_max` (Number) Applies to container backups sent to PBS. Limits the number of entries allowed in memory at a given time to avoid unintended OOM situations. Increase it to enable backups of containers with a large amount of files.


<a id="nestedatt--backup_jobs--prune_backups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `backup_jobs.prune_backups`

Read-Only:

- `keep_all` (Boolean) Keep all backups. Conflicts with the other options when true.
- `keep_daily` (Number) Keep backups for the last <N> different days. If there is morethan one backup for a single day, only the latest one is kept.
- `keep_hourly` (Number) Keep backups for the last <N> different hours. If there is morethan one backup for a single hour, only the latest one is kept.
- `keep_last` (Number) Keep the last <N> backups.
- `keep_monthly` (Number) Keep backups for the last <N> different months. If there is morethan one backup for a single month, only the latest one is kept.
- `keep_weekly` (Number) Keep backups for the last <N> different weeks. If there is morethan one backup for a single week, only the latest one is kept.
- `keep_yearly` (Number) Keep backups for the last <N> different years. If there is morethan one backup for a single year, only the latest one is kept.



<a id="nestedatt--included_volumes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `included_volumes`

Read-Only:

- `children` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--included_volumes--children))

<a id="nestedatt--included_volumes--children"></a>
### Nested Schema for `included_volumes.children`

Read-Only:

- `api_id` (Number) VMID of the guest.
- `children` (Attributes List) The volumes of the guest with the information if they will be included in backups. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--included_volumes--children--children))
- `name` (String) Name of the guest
- `type` (String) Type of the guest, VM, CT or unknown for removed but not purged guests.

<a id="nestedatt--included_volumes--children--children"></a>
### Nested Schema for `included_volumes.children.children`

Read-Only:

- `api_id` (String) Configuration key of the volume.
- `included` (Boolean) Whether the volume is included in the backup or not.
- `name` (String) Name of the volume.
- `reason` (String) The reason why the volume is included (or excluded).
